run_form_composer_cli: run the form_composer CLI to generate form-based tasks with Bootstrap forms and client-side validation
run_form_composer_config_verify: run the form_composer config verify command to validate all JSON configs in the form builder directory
run_form_composer_config_update_file_url: run the form_composer config command to update separate-token values with file URLs from an S3 folder
run_form_composer_config_permutate_token: run the form_composer config command to create token sets as all permutations of separate-token values
run_form_composer_config_extrapolate: run the form_composer config command to generate form versions based on extrapolated token sets values
